All Implemented Interfaces:
Runnable, robocode.robotinterfaces.IAdvancedEvents, robocode.robotinterfaces.IAdvancedRobot, robocode.robotinterfaces.IBasicEvents, robocode.robotinterfaces.IBasicEvents2, robocode.robotinterfaces.IBasicEvents3, robocode.robotinterfaces.IBasicRobot, robocode.robotinterfaces.IInteractiveEvents, robocode.robotinterfaces.IInteractiveRobot, robocode.robotinterfaces.IPaintEvents, robocode.robotinterfaces.IPaintRobot
public class Sanaro extends robocode.AdvancedRobot
Sanaro, a NanoMelee robot (docs/sanaro.md): anti-gravity from where each robot is about to be, turned SPIRAL off the field's direction so it circles the robot shooting at it instead of fleeing it straight, with a radar that sweeps while the gun cools and flips on the target once it is nearly ready, a hedged lead and a table of bullet power by both robots' energy. The anti-gravity and the hedge come from the open DustBunny, Quantum and NaturalScience line; the spiral, the table and the radar's threshold are Sanaro's. One class within NanoMelee's 249 bytes (SANARO-1).
